name: Honnō-ji Temple
heritage: Registered Tangible Cultural Property of Japan
text: Honnō-ji (本能寺) is a temple of the Nichiren branch of Buddhism located in Kyoto, Japan.

depictions.name: Honno-Ji
depictions.text: Honnō-ji (本能寺) is a Nichiren Buddhist temple located in the city of Kyoto, Japan. The temple is most notable for the incident that saw Akechi Mitsuhide, one of Oda Nobunaga's closest generals and a secret Shinbakufu member, betray his lord by forcing him to commit seppuku, an event which came to be known as the Honnō-ji incident.
